title: God's Plan: the physical side (Isaac) and the spiritual side (Yeshua)
summary: Two columns under the heading 'God's Plan': the Physical side (marked with a Star of David) says that if Isaac is sacrificed the physical side of God's plan cannot occur; the Spiritual side (marked with a cross) says that if yeshua is not sacrificed the spiritual side of God's plan cannot occur.

text.text: If Isaac is Sacrificed, the Physical Side of God’s Plan cannot occur.
If yeshua is not Sacrificed, the Spiritual Side of God’s Plan cannot occur.
